slots.default: What happens when you raise something

slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Every request lands in the same place and gets graded P1 to P5. A P1 is reserved for something that stops the business, like a total outage or a dead server, and gets immediate attention. Lower priorities still carry a committed response time, so nothing quietly rots at the bottom of a queue.

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: We’ll respond the same working day, and most issues are resolved on that first contact. When something genuinely needs hands on the hardware, one of our field engineers travels to you and we aim to be with you the same working day.

slots.default: People who already know your setup

slots.label: Paragraph 4
slots.default: We deliberately keep our client list small rather than running thousands of accounts, which means the person picking up your ticket has probably worked on your systems before and does not need the whole history explaining again.
